messages.content: TRACE is a field-first maintenance and inspection app: technicians open a pump, compressor or air handler, record readings, photos and Pass/Watch/Fail calls at the inspection points pinned to a 3D view of the machine, and raise corrective work that a supervisor dispatches. It works offline first and syncs later.

TRACE is an Uno Platform single-project app at Trace/Trace.csproj (Uno.Sdk 7.0.5, pinned in global.json). Heads: net10.0-desktop, net10.0-browserwasm, net10.0-android and net10.0-ios.

**Key files:**
- Trace/App.xaml.cs: the host (configuration with AppConfig.Technician from appsettings.json, logging, localization, theme switching), every service registered in DI, and the routes: Main with Today, Assets, Scan, Sync, Findings and Asset nested in one Visibility region. App.Verification.cs holds Debug-only verification hooks (--trace-route, --trace-theme and others), never compiled in Release.
- Trace/Domain/: immutable records (Asset, AssetSummary, InspectionPoint, InspectionDraft, InspectionEvent, Evidence, CorrectiveAction, SyncOperation), enums, and InspectionRules (reading validation, Fail needs a note or a photo, out of range asks for an explicit call, one corrective action per failed inspection).
- Trace/Services/: the interfaces (repositories, IInspectionWorkflow, IActionDispatch, ISyncQueue, INetworkStatusService, ICameraService, IAssetScanService, ILocalEvidenceStore, ITraceStore).
- Trace/Infrastructure/: TraceStore keeps one JSON file per section under LocalFolder/trace through a source-generated System.Text.Json context; a change to several sections goes through a journal (commit.json) so it lands whole, and an unreadable file is set aside and reported on Sync. Repositories project the store's snapshot stream. SyncQueue is the outbox: inspections are sent before the corrective work raised from them. Platform/ holds the simulated camera, tag scanner and network; Seed/ the P-204 pump scenario. CrashReporter logs what nothing else caught to crash.log.
- Trace/Presentation/: one MVUX model per page (TodayModel, AssetsModel, ScanModel, SyncModel, SupervisorFindingsModel, MainModel for the shell, AssetModel for the asset workspace). AssetWorkspaceParts, a container service, builds the workspace's parts: PointInspectorModel with its PointEvidenceModel, CorrectiveActionSheetModel and EvidenceViewerModel, each bound to its own control in Presentation/Controls. Each asset tab is a control (AssetOverviewTab, AssetInspectTab, AssetHistoryTab, AssetDocumentsTab). ScreenText holds the words screens put on domain values, reached from XAML through converters.
- Trace/Presentation/Scene3D/: a CPU 3D pipeline over SkiaSharp (SceneRenderer, SceneCamera, parametric EquipmentModels whose parts name an EquipmentPaint, GltfEquipmentLoader for Assets/Models/p-204.glb). AssetSceneView draws through SKCanvasElement; SpatialMarkerLayout pins the point markers to the projected anchors.
- Trace/Styles/ColorPaletteOverride.xaml: the palette, the one place brand colours live (all 33 colour keys in Light and Default, read through MaterialToolkitTheme.Colors / ThemeColors.OverrideSource). Uno Platform Studio's Themes tab edits it.
- Trace/App.xaml: the theme, and the colours no palette role covers in its Light and Default theme dictionaries: Success* and Watch* (the Pass and Watch statuses), ScrimColor (sheet scrim, the 3D ground shadow), SceneFillLightColor, and Equipment*Color (the parametric machines' paint, read by AssetSceneView for its theme).
- Trace/Themes/: Layout.xaml (only the layout values no theme token covers: two-axis insets, widths, part sizes), Styles.xaml (surfaces, text roles based on the Material type styles, feed templates), Markers.xaml (point marker and disposition button templates), Icons.xaml, Converters.xaml.

**Patterns and traps:**
- MVUX everywhere: models are partial records, pages bind with {Binding}, never x:Bind. Public async methods become commands. FeedRecovery restarts the store watches after a failed read, behind every page's Try again.
- AssetViewModel.cs adds the parts' generated view models (Inspector, Inspector.Evidence, ActionSheet, Viewer) to the page's; those partials carry [ReactiveBindable(false)] so MVUX does not take them for models.
- The asset shares the destinations' Visibility region, whose navigator reuses a view model it already has, so MainPage takes the closed asset's model off the region before the next asset opens. MainPage also lays out both navigation bars once at launch, because a TabBar first laid out later navigates to its selected item.
- There is no Application/ folder: a Trace.Application namespace would shadow Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application.
- Uno 7 defines ANDROID, IOS, WINDOWS, __WASM__ and __DESKTOP__. Uno0001 and every other warning are errors (Directory.Build.props).
- Hot Design and App MCP run in Debug; NO_UNO_STUDIO, when a build defines it, compiles UseStudio() out.

**Navigation and theming:** region-based Navigation Extensions with ViewMap and a DataViewMap that passes the tapped AssetSummary to the workspace; NavigationOrigin records the destination last shown so the asset's Back returns to it. Material (MaterialToolkitTheme), Dark by default, with a Light/Dark switch on Today that IThemeService remembers. The look comes from the theme: use the role brushes with {ThemeResource} (OnSurfaceBrush, OnSurfaceVariantBrush, PrimaryBrush, SurfaceBrush, SurfaceVariantBrush, OutlineVariantBrush, ErrorContainerBrush… with their On* pair; OnSurfaceHoverBrush/OnSurfacePressedBrush for state layers), the Material type styles, and the theme's tokens by value (SpaceN00 = N x 8 px and RadiusN00 = N x 4 px on this theme: Space050 = 4, Space100 = 8, Space150 = 12, Space200 = 16, Space300 = 24; Radius200 = 8 … Radius500 = 20; ControlHeightMediumLarge = 44 for touch targets). Never a hex colour, FontSize, FontFamily or CornerRadius literal in pages, and no colour literal in C#: a new brand colour goes into the palette, a colour with no role into App.xaml's Light and Default dictionaries. utu:Responsive on the Toolkit's breakpoints: a bottom bar below 600 and a rail from 600; the point inspector is a sheet below 800 and docks from 800.

**What is simulated:** the camera returns bundled sample photos and can be denied on demand, Scan presents the next tagged asset, the network is a switch on Today, and the sync transport fails a photo upload on its first attempt and sends it on retry. There is no server.

**Build:** `dotnet build Trace/Trace.csproj -f net10.0-desktop`. The unit tests live in the development repository, noknowscode/trace. `-p:TraceTargetFrameworks=<tfm>` builds one head.

The app is built and running. The user may ask me to modify it.
